Clearing the data would erase the settings, the alarms and the launcher pairing with the TV. Nothing was deleted. To start from scratch, use the panel backup or a computer (adb).
Make the launcher the device owner

This turns Google off for a few seconds (the account is kept and comes back on its own) and makes the launcher the device owner: hide apps, pin HOME and block stop or clear. Do it with nobody using the TV.
The extra users on the TV will also be REMOVED, with their data: %s.
Making the launcher the owner… (up to 1 minute)
The own shell did not answer. Pair it in Settings > Launcher shell.
In About, go down to "Android TV OS build" and press OK 7 times. Then come back here.
Pair the launcher with the TV
Opens Developer options: turn on "Wireless debugging" and open "Pair device with pairing code". The launcher reads the code by itself.
Make the launcher the device owner
Hides apps, pins HOME and blocks stop or clear. Google turns off for a few seconds; the account stays.
